title: introduce-intake-normalizer-and-variant-signal-aggregator
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context & motivation: model intake today accepts heterogeneous manifests from partners and community models. We repeatedly see small metadata inconsistencies (missing license fields, malformed affinity hints, and sparse telemetry buckets) that block downstream profile generation and make changelog automation noisy. This PR introduces a model intake normalizer and a variant signal aggregator that: normalizes incoming manifests to schema v2, validates and auto-fills common missing metadata, computes per-variant affinity and sample-coverage signals from sampled telemetry, seeds a per-variant calibration profile that the registry can use for rollout heuristics, and emits a concise micro-changelog skeleton to help release note automation.

What this PR does (high level): adds a new intake-normalizer CLI (python) and a library module (registry.ingest.normalize) that performs deterministic normalization and canonicalization; introduces schema v2 for model profiles (profile_schema_v2.json) with explicit "affinity_score" and "sample_coverage" fields; implements a signal-aggregator that consumes sampled telemetry (usage buckets) to produce weighted variant signals; provides a migration/backfill script that computes and populates sample_coverage for recent 90-day windows; integrates a release-drafter hook that creates a short, human-editable changelog fragment when a new model version is onboarded; tightens provenance recording to include transform hashes so downstream reproducibility is possible.

Checklist: * [x] normalization library and CLI implemented * [x] schema v2 added and validated against unit tests * [x] backfill/migration script included with idempotency checks * [x] small integration test that runs intake -> aggregator -> seeded profile -> changelog snippet generation * [x] docs (docs/ingest/normalizer.md) and migration notes * [x] Linear tickets linked and basic QA performed

Commits (summary): - add intake normalizer module and CLI (normalize manifests, canonicalize keys, fill defaults) - add profile_schema_v2.json and validator with tests - implement signal-aggregator (weighted-variant-score algorithm, serialized seed writer) - migration script backfill/sample-coverage-populator and safety guard - add release-drafter hook and changelog fragment template - add unit + integration tests and small e2e harness - docs and changelog entry explaining schema migration

Files changed (high level): registry/ingest/normalizer.py, registry/ingest/aggregator.py, registry/schema/profile_schema_v2.json, registry/migrations/202511_backfill_sample_coverage.sql, scripts/intake_cli.py, tests/ingest/test_normalizer.py, tests/ingest/test_aggregator_integration.py, docs/ingest/normalizer.md, tooling/release_hooks/draft_micro_changelog.py.

Compatibility & migration notes: profile_schema_v2 is additive; v1 consumers will ignore new numeric fields but we still provide a compatibility shim that exposes affinity_score as a hint in v1 payloads. The migration script is guarded by a --dry-run flag and transactions; operators should run dry-run and validate a sample of entries before applying. We also added a small telemetry sampler cap to avoid over-sampling high-traffic variants during aggregation.

Security and provenance: the normalizer records a transform hash (SHA256) and signed provenance metadata when run in operator mode; the migration script supports optional KMS signing for enterprise Private installs (not enabled by default). Reviewed by security to ensure no secrets are written to logs.

Testing & CI: unit tests cover normalization permutations and schema validation; integration test runs a small synthetic telemetry dump through the aggregator and asserts seeded profiles are within expected signal ranges. CI initially had a flake in linting (line-length in docs) which was fixed; e2e job required an environment variable to be set in CI (REGISTRY_TEST_SAMPLER=1) and was rerun. Final CI status: pass.

Release notes / consumer-facing impact: this adds a new model intake tool and improves onboarding quality by reducing manual metadata cleanups and by pre-seeding calibration signals that improve automatic rollout decisions. No breaking API changes. Operators should plan a short migration window to run the backfill script. See the docs/ingest/normalizer.md for steps.

review_comments: Lin Zhao: Request change - affinity_score should be rounded to 4 decimal places before storage to avoid precision drift. Also add a unit test that asserts deterministic normalization for key casing.
Aisha Patel: Reply - added rounding and deterministic key-ordering in normalizer; included new unit test (test_normalizer_deterministic).
Sofia Ruiz: Comment - migration should be idempotent; please ensure backfill skips already-populated rows.
Aisha Patel: Reply - backfill now checks sample_coverage IS NULL and includes a --force flag. Added transaction wrapper.
Marcus King: Approved - CI green and manual spot checks on a sampled dataset looked good.
ci_checks: security-scan: pass (no secrets, provenance signing optional)
release_notes: Add intake normalizer and variant signal aggregator; introduce profile_schema_v2 with affinity_score and sample_coverage; migration/backfill provided; improves onboarding metadata quality and seeds calibration profiles to support safer rollouts.
notes_for_ops: Run registry/migrations/202511_backfill_sample_coverage.sql in a maintenance window. Start with --dry-run and validate results on a sample of 1k models. Ensure REGISTRY_TEST_SAMPLER env var set if running e2e locally.
